x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"value\":\"string\"}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/estimating/notes", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

x-code-samples.title: Curl
x-code-samples.content:
curl --request POST \
  --url https://api.procore.com/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/estimating/notes \
  --header 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data '{"value":"string"}'
